topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
source_evidence: Each of these cash management programs offer different benefits and risks, including different interest rates and insurance coverage, or protection (FDIC or SIPC).
answer: When you open a brokerage account, you may need to choose how to handle cash that is not invested. Depending on the firm, options may include automatically sweeping cash into bank deposit accounts, sweeping it into one or more money market mutual funds, or leaving it in the brokerage account. The firm may choose a default option, and it may not offer every option. Before selecting a program, compare its terms, benefits, and risks—including the interest rates and insurance coverage or protection that apply. Ask your broker if anything is unclear.
